outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of micrographs (pseudocoloured confocal images), not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter-type plots of normalized intensity over time (H1.1, RCC1, H1t) where the raw individual measurement points (green and red markers) are plotted directly along with the fitted model curves, rather than only showing an averaged summary curve. The insets show averaged early time-point responses with error bars, but these are derived from the same type of underlying scatter data shown in the main plots; as line/scatter plots, they are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.
